instructions: Marinate the meat with soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaves, and peppercorn. Simmer until the meat becomes tender and the sauce is reduced.
Boil the meat or seafood with tomatoes. Add tamarind mix and vegetables, then simmer until cooked.
Boil the meat until tender. Add peanut sauce, ground rice, and vegetables. Serve with bagoong.
Saute garlic, onion, and ginger. Add chicken and fish sauce. Pour water and simmer, then add papaya and malunggay.
Saute garlic and onion. Add pork, shrimp paste, coconut milk, and chili peppers. Simmer until the sauce thickens.
Saute tomato, garlic, and onion. Add vegetables and shrimp paste, then cook until vegetables are tender.
Cook dried taro leaves in coconut milk with garlic, onion, ginger, chili, and shrimp paste until creamy.
Saute garlic and onion. Add pork and liver, then simmer with tomato sauce, potatoes, carrots, and raisins.
Saute garlic and onion. Add meat, tomato sauce, potatoes, carrots, and bell pepper. Simmer until cooked.
Saute garlic, onion, meat, and shrimp. Add vegetables, soy sauce, and noodles. Cook until noodles are tender.
Mix ground pork, vegetables, and egg. Wrap in spring roll wrappers and deep-fry until golden brown.
Boil pork belly with spices until tender. Dry the pork, then deep-fry until crispy.
Marinate chicken in calamansi, vinegar, garlic, ginger, and lemongrass. Grill while brushing with annatto oil.
Boil beef shank and bone marrow until tender. Add corn and vegetables, then simmer before serving.
Layer sweet ingredients in a glass. Add crushed ice, evaporated milk, leche flan, and ube ice cream.
